1.explanation:
• DataTable/README.md – describes the DataTable API including the TableBatchAction component so you can see how iconDescription is documented (or omitted) in the public API.  
• DataTable/migrate-to-7.x.md – shows any migration notes around batch actions or iconDescription defaults when upgrading carbon-components-react.  
• DataTable/stories/TableBatchAction.stories.js – the interactive story that reproduces the bug (with and without iconDescription), so you can launch it locally and inspect the rendered button.  
• Button/migrate-to-7.x.md – explains the default iconDescription for IconButton/Button components and how it changed in v7, which is the root of the wrong default “Add”.  
• Icon/migrate-to-7.x.md – covers the default behavior and prop types for the Icon component that underlies IconButton, showing how iconDescription flows down.  
• DataTable/state/batch-actions-state.js – contains the internal logic for rendering the batch action buttons (text vs. icon) and wiring up the iconDescription prop; needed to trace how the default value is applied.
1.bug_scenario: The issue occurs in the DataTable’s batch-action bar when the individual batch-action buttons render only an icon (no visible text): by default each IconButton’s iconDescription prop is “Add” (so screen readers announce “Add Button” even on the Edit, Reset, or Cancel icons). The first screenshot (“iconDescription not provided”) shows the Edit button reading aloud as “Edit Add Button”. In the second screenshot (“iconDescription provided”) the caller has explicitly passed iconDescription and you can see JAWS now announces “Edit Edit Button”. In both cases, the visible UI shows only the icon, so a default of “Add” is wrong and iconDescription should default to an empty string unless the caller supplies it.
